Question: ASSALAM-W-ALAIKUM,MY QU.IS 1.CAN I DO NIKAH IN ZOHAR & WALIMA AFTER ISHA. I MEAN IS IT NECESSARY FOR HUSBAND &WIFE TO SPEND SOMETIME WITH EACHOTHER BEFORE WALIMA. 2.OR IS IT POSSIBLE TO CELIBRATE NIKAH & WALIMA PARTI IN SAME TIME. Zazak-allau-khairan. Answer ID: 21932 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/705/M=1431) (1) Nikah may be held in Zuhar and valima after Isha salah. It is not necessary for husband and wife to pass some time together before valima. However, doing valima after meeting of the spouses is sunnah and mustahab. (2) Valima should be held after nikah or rukhsati. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
